file manifest as "uncommitted working-tree changes, no commit/push" against base
HEAD 38e8c62. That caveat is now stale: at main aa91cc9 the working tree is clean
and the manifest's SHA-256 values match the committed files exactly --- spot-checked
InteractionCompiler.scala (f162d9c3...), InteractionBinding.scala (ebca7c12...) and
interaction/InteractionState.scala (1669ce57...), all three unchanged from the note.
The work described is on main and pushed.

Independently verified green at aa91cc9: SBT_OPTS=-Xmx6g sbt scalafmtCheckAll testAll
passed all fifteen module/platform targets, 1370 tests, 0 failures. CI run 34480564047
on the parent commit 2eefd37 passed all six jobs (style+docs, four Scala/JDK cells,
compatibility).

Status left at "doing" deliberately: the bead's own pending list is unaddressed.
